description:
This is an official video on Bespoke AI Refrigerator with AI Family Hub. The AI Family Hub is a fun way to communicate and access entertainment services. It also updates a food list and suggests recipes and food to buy. Auto Open Door has sensors on both sides that helps you open the door when you lightly touch them. Newly updated Samsung Bixby allows you to control the Family Hub refrigerator’s features remotely, and even open the fridge with just your voice. AI Energy Mode reduces your energy use by up to 10% by intelligently adjusting the compressor speed and the frequency of the defrost cycle, based on your usage pattern and surroundings.

Learn more: http://spr.ly/6053BDxq5z
